data.claim: The idempotent-vs-safe distinction is best understood through counterexample: a random-UUID writer is neither idempotent nor safe under retry; a deterministic-hash writer is safe but not idempotent; a check-then-append writer is idempotent in effect but requires a read path that contradicts append-only discipline. The log requires the safe-but-non-idempotent writer (property b).
